item.title: Remove all of the diacritics from a file
item.description:
I like iconv as it handles all accents variations :

cat non-ascii.txt | iconv -f utf8 -t ascii//TRANSLIT//IGNORE > ascii.txt

item.title: Configure mosquitto to use websockets
item.description:
Add the following lines to /etc/mosquitto/mosquitto.conf in the “Default Listener” section: 


 port 1883
 listener 9001
 protocol websockets
